method: Fresh authenticated POST /ocr for every image. Identical saved text replayed locally before and after parser changes. Currency conversion disabled; default currency USD for this benchmark.

reviewed_corrections.review: Image shows printed 41.31, gratuity 3.00, handwritten final 44.31. OCR reads final as 4431; restore cents only with exact total-plus-tip agreement.
Image shows total 17.80; 20.00 belongs to the signature requirement notice.
Image shows final subtotal 152.00 after a 12.00 comp, and tax 0.00. Total is clipped; 152.00 is derived from visible components.
Image shows IKEA Milton Keynes and UK VAT registration GB527773320; currency GBP.

verification.adapter_method: Local _parse_bill and _convert_currency replay with captured OCR text, fixed test rates, USD default, and inline thread runner; no transaction writes.

limitations: Three amount corrections and one currency correction were reviewed; the whole dataset lacks complete image-labelled ground truth.
The 152.00 Zoca amount is reconstructed from visible subtotal and tax, not a readable printed total.
16 receipts still lack dates; 7 lack vendors; 58 use the configured default currency.
54 selected OCR snapshots are targeted regression tests, not an unbiased accuracy estimate.
New parser source was tested locally with live OCR text; it has not been deployed.
Legacy OCR Groq SealedSecret is retained until the local-parser image replaces the currently deployed Groq image.
